stem: Which condition may ultrasound identify in a child with acute abdominal pain?
explanation: Renal calculi are the correct answer. In selected cases, ultrasound may identify renal calculi, whereas pneumonia is assessed with chest X-ray, obstruction with abdominal X-ray when suspected, and ultrasound has no role in testicular torsion.

optionExplanations.A: Correct because ultrasound may identify renal calculi in selected cases.
optionExplanations.B: Incorrect because pneumonia is linked to chest X-ray rather than ultrasound.
optionExplanations.C: Incorrect because suspected bowel obstruction is assessed with abdominal X-ray, not ultrasound as the primary test.
optionExplanations.D: Incorrect because ultrasound has no role in testicular torsion in this context.
optionExplanations.E: Incorrect because ultrasound is not used to identify every cause of acute abdominal pain.
